images.caption: Figure 3:Overview of Prune to Expand (P2E).Given a short prompt and its paired dense caption, an LLM generatesKKnested candidates by progressively removing sentences weakly related to user intent. Retained sentences remain unchanged and in their original order. Extent-constrained selection then chooses the candidate with the largest token deletion ratio within the per-example boundτ\tauas the refined supervision target for PE. Green checks and red crosses indicate retained and removed sentences, respectively. The pruning process is entirely text-only, requiring no image generation or visual scoring.

Figure 4:Qualitative comparison of prompt enhancement methods.From left to right: w/o PE, Raw PE, SFT (Unpruned), and SFT (P2E). The original prompt is shown above each row. P2E enhances structural coherence, spatial balance, and visual richness while faithfully preserving user intent, as reflected in clearer scene depth, more accurate subject attributes, and richer fine-grained details.
